topic: The 2010 overflow bug that briefly created 184 billion bitcoin
title: The 2010 Bitcoin Bug That Created 184 Billion BTC
hook: In 2010, a Bitcoin block created 184 billion coins.

scenes.narration: The checking code did not account for outputs so large they overflowed when summed. One block created over 184 billion bitcoin.
A fixed client came out in about five hours and rejected overflow transactions.
The patched chain overtook the bad one the next day, so those coins no longer exist on the longest chain.

cta: What would you have checked first? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: In August 2010 a bug briefly created 184 billion bitcoin. Here is how it was undone.
